# KiwiFS — Full Reference for LLMs

> Markdown filesystem for agents and teams. Searchable. Structured. Versioned.

KiwiFS is a single Go binary that turns markdown files on disk into a searchable, queryable, versioned store accessible via REST, MCP, NFS, S3, WebDAV, and FUSE. Every write is a git commit. Search is built-in (BM25 via SQLite FTS5 + optional vector embeddings). Frontmatter metadata is queryable with DQL, a SQL-like language. A web UI with wiki links, knowledge graph, Bases, canvas, Kanban, and comments is included.

Documentation: https://docs.kiwifs.com
GitHub: https://github.com/kiwifs/kiwifs
OpenAPI spec (self-hosted): GET /api/openapi.json

---

## Installation

    # Shell one-liner
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kiwifs/kiwifs/main/install.sh | sh

    # Go
    go install github.com/kiwifs/kiwifs@latest

    # Docker
    docker run -p 3333:3333 -v ./knowledge:/data ameliaanhlam/kiwifs

## Init and Serve

    kiwifs init --template knowledge --root ./knowledge
    kiwifs serve --root ./knowledge

Server starts at http://localhost:3333 with the web UI, REST API, and optional NFS/S3/WebDAV.

## Init Templates

    kiwifs init --template <name> --root <dir>

| Template   | Description                                             |
|------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| knowledge  | LLM-maintained knowledge base with schema, episodes, playbook |
| wiki       | Team wiki                                                |
| runbook    | Ops/incidents runbook                                    |
| research   | Research notes                                           |
| tasks      | Task tracking with workflow schema                       |
| blank      | Config only, no starter files                            |

The `knowledge` template creates:
- SCHEMA.md — directory layout, frontmatter field tables, naming conventions
- .kiwi/playbook.md — MCP tool sequences for each operation
- .kiwi/rules.md — agent behavior per harness (Cursor, Claude, etc.)
- index.md — auto-maintained table of contents
- log.md — append-only change log
- episodes/ — episodic memory directory
- pages/ — durable knowledge pages

---

## Configuration

Config file: .kiwi/config.toml (supports ${ENV_VAR} expansion)

Key sections:

    [server]
    host = "0.0.0.0"
    port = 3333

    [search]
    engine = "sqlite"           # sqlite (FTS5) or grep
    [search.vector]
    embedder = "ollama"         # ollama, openai, cohere, voyage, http, bedrock, vertex
    store = "sqlite-vec"

    [versioning]
    strategy = "git"            # git, cow, or none

    [auth]
    type = "none"               # none, apikey, perspace, oidc
    api_key = "kiwi_sk_..."

    [backup]
    remote = "git@github.com:org/knowledge.git"

    [webhooks]
    [schema]
    enforce = true
    [drafts]
    enabled = true
    [audit]
    enabled = true

---

## REST API Reference

Base URL: http://localhost:3333/api/kiwi
Auth: Bearer token in Authorization header
Common headers: X-Actor (git author), X-Provenance (lineage), If-Match (ETag), X-Kiwi-Space (multi-space)

### Files

    GET    /tree                              List all files
    GET    /file?path=concepts/auth.md        Read file (returns content + frontmatter + ETag)
    PUT    /file?path=concepts/auth.md        Create or update (body = markdown, set X-Actor)
    DELETE /file?path=concepts/auth.md        Delete file
    POST   /rename                            Move/rename: {"from": "old.md", "to": "new.md"}
    POST   /rename-dir                        Rename directory
    POST   /bulk                              Atomic multi-file write: {"files": [...]}
    POST   /file/append                       Append to file: {"path": "log.md", "content": "..."}
    POST   /assets                            Upload binary asset
    POST   /resolve-links                     Resolve wiki-link targets
    GET    /readlink?path=link.md             Read symlink target
    GET    /changes?since=<checkpoint>         Incremental change list

### Search

    GET    /search?q=authentication            BM25 full-text search
    GET    /search/verified?q=auth              Trust-ranked results
    POST   /search/semantic                    Vector similarity: {"query": "...", "limit": 5}
    GET    /search/semantic?q=auth             GET form of semantic search

### Versioning

    GET    /versions?path=concepts/auth.md     Git history for a file
    GET    /version?path=auth.md&version=abc   Read file at specific revision
    GET    /diff?path=auth.md&from=abc&to=def  Diff between two revisions
    GET    /blame?path=concepts/auth.md        Git blame

### Metadata and DQL

    GET    /query?q=TABLE title,status FROM 'concepts' WHERE status='draft'
    GET    /query/aggregate?group=status&calc=count
    GET    /meta?path=concepts/auth.md         Raw frontmatter metadata
    GET    /backlinks?path=concepts/auth.md    Incoming wiki links
    GET    /graph                              Full wiki-link graph (nodes + edges)

### Graph Analytics

    GET    /graph/analytics?limit=20           PageRank, component analysis, orphans
    GET    /graph/centrality?limit=50          PageRank and betweenness per page
    GET    /graph/communities                  Louvain community detection
    GET    /graph/path?from=a.md&to=b.md       Shortest path between pages
    GET    /graph/walk?path=a.md               One-hop neighbors and backlinks

### Drafts (staging branches)

    POST   /drafts                             Create: {"name": "feature-x"}
    GET    /drafts                             List active drafts
    GET    /drafts/:id                         Draft details
    GET    /drafts/:id/diff                    Diff vs main
    POST   /drafts/:id/merge                   Merge into main
    DELETE /drafts/:id                         Discard draft
    GET    /drafts/:id/file?path=...           Read file in draft
    PUT    /drafts/:id/file?path=...           Write file in draft
    DELETE /drafts/:id/file?path=...           Delete file in draft
    GET    /drafts/:id/tree                    List files in draft

### Views (Bases)

    GET    /views                              List saved views
    GET    /views/:name                        Get view definition
    PUT    /views/:name                        Save view (DQL + layout)
    DELETE /views/:name                        Delete view
    GET    /views/:name/execute                Run view query, get rows

### Canvas

    GET    /canvases                           List canvas files
    GET    /canvas?path=overview.canvas.json    Read canvas
    PUT    /canvas?path=...                    Write canvas
    DELETE /canvas?path=...                    Delete canvas
    PATCH  /canvas?path=...                    Patch canvas nodes/edges
    GET    /canvas/query?path=...              Query canvas elements
    POST   /canvas/auto-layout                 Reposition existing canvas nodes
    POST   /canvas/generate                    Generate canvas from graph

### Workflows (Kanban)

    GET    /workflows                          List workflow definitions
    GET    /workflows/:name                    Get workflow definition
    PUT    /workflows/:name                    Save workflow definition
    DELETE /workflows/:name                    Delete workflow
    POST   /workflow/assign                    Assign file to workflow
    POST   /workflow/advance                   Advance file state
    POST   /workflow/reorder                   Reorder items on board
    GET    /workflow/board/:workflow            Kanban board view

### Claims (cooperative leases)

    POST   /claim                              Acquire lease: {"path": "...", "actor": "...", "ttl": "5m"}
    DELETE /claim                              Release lease
    GET    /claims                             List active claims

### Publishing

    POST   /publish                            Publish a page
    POST   /publish/bulk                       Bulk publish
    POST   /unpublish                          Unpublish a page
    POST   /unpublish/bulk                     Bulk unpublish
    GET    /publish/status?path=...            Check publish status
    GET    /publish/list                       List published pages
    GET    /p/*                                Public permalink (no auth)

### Webhooks

    POST   /webhooks                           Register webhook: {"url": "...", "events": ["write","delete"]}
    GET    /webhooks                           List webhooks
    DELETE /webhooks/:id                       Remove webhook

### Schemas (JSON Schema validation)

    GET    /schemas                            List schema definitions
    GET    /schemas/:type                      Get schema for a type
    PUT    /schemas/:type                      Save schema definition

### Import and Export

    POST   /import                             Import from source: {"from": "postgres", "dsn": "...", ...}
    POST   /import/upload                      Upload file for import
    POST   /import/browse                      Browse tables/collections
    POST   /import/preview                     Preview records
    GET    /import/connections                  List saved connections
    POST   /import/connections                  Save connection
    DELETE /import/connections/:id              Delete connection
    POST   /import/connections/:id/run          Re-run import
    GET    /import/sources                      List supported sources
    POST   /ingest                             Convert binary doc to markdown
    POST   /clip                               Web clip: {"url": "https://...", "folder": "clips/"}
    GET    /export?format=jsonl&path=concepts/  Export as JSONL, CSV, or Parquet
    POST   /export/document                    Render to PDF/HTML/slides/site

### Analytics and Health

    GET    /analytics                          Knowledge base health dashboard
    GET    /analytics/overview                 Compact dashboard
    GET    /analytics/views                    Page view stats
    GET    /analytics/views/v2?path=auth.md    Per-page engagement
    GET    /analytics/searches                 Search query log
    GET    /analytics/failed-searches          Failed searches (content gaps)
    GET    /analytics/trends                   Activity trends
    GET    /analytics/content-gaps             Content gap suggestions
    POST   /analytics/content-gaps/dismiss     Dismiss a suggestion
    GET    /analytics/sources                  Pages by import source
    GET    /health-check?path=auth.md          Per-page health
    GET    /stale                              Overdue review pages
    GET    /contradictions                     Conflicting claims across pages
    GET    /suggestions?path=auth.md           Semantically similar pages
    GET    /embeddings?path=auth.md            Raw embedding vectors
    POST   /eval                               Search quality benchmark
    GET    /janitor                            Full health scan
    GET    /memory/report                      Episodic memory coverage
    GET    /velocity?period=14d                Change velocity analysis

### Utilities

    GET    /context                            Agent playbook + schema + index
    GET    /rules                              Get .kiwi/rules.md
    GET    /rules?format=cursor                Get rules formatted for Cursor
    PUT    /rules                              Update rules.md
    POST   /lint                               Lint markdown
    GET    /peek?path=auth.md                  Lightweight page summary
    GET    /section?path=auth.md&heading=OAuth  Extract one heading section
    GET    /toc?path=auth.md                   Table of contents
    GET    /timeline?limit=50                  Activity timeline
    GET    /feed.xml                           Atom feed
    GET    /feed.json                          JSON feed
    GET    /templates                          List page templates
    GET    /template?name=meeting-notes        Get a page template body
    GET    /backup/status                      Backup status
    GET    /audit?since=2026-05-01T00:00:00Z   Audit log entries
    GET    /space/info                         Space visibility and root
    PUT    /space/visibility                   Set public/unlisted/private

### Real-time Events (SSE)

    GET    /events                             Server-Sent Events stream

Event types: write, delete, bulk, import

### Comments

    GET    /comments?path=auth.md              List comments
    POST   /comments?path=auth.md              Add comment: {"line": 15, "body": "..."}
    PATCH  /comments/:id                       Resolve: {"resolved": true}
    DELETE /comments/:id                       Delete comment

### Sharing

    POST   /share                              Create share link
    GET    /share?path=auth.md                 List share links for page
    DELETE /share/:id                          Revoke share link

### Theme

    GET    /theme                              Get UI theme
    PUT    /theme                              Set theme: {"primary": "#6cbe45", "mode": "light"}

### Multi-space Administration

    GET    /api/spaces                         List spaces (outside /api/kiwi)
    POST   /api/spaces                         Create space: {"name": "team", "root": "./team"}
    DELETE /api/spaces/:name                   Delete space
    GET    /api/init-templates                 List init templates

### Infrastructure

    GET    /health                             Basic health check
    GET    /healthz                            Liveness probe (uptime, version)
    GET    /readyz                             Readiness probe
    GET    /metrics                            Prometheus metrics
    GET    /api/openapi.json                   OpenAPI 3.0 spec
    GET    /api/docs                           Swagger UI

### Error Format

All errors return JSON: {"error": "message"}
Status codes: 400 (bad request), 401 (unauthorized), 404 (not found), 409 (conflict/ETag mismatch), 422 (validation), 501 (feature disabled), 503 (optional service unavailable), 500 (internal error)

---

## MCP Server

KiwiFS ships a built-in MCP server. Transports: stdio (default), Streamable HTTP (--http).

### Setup

    # In-process (local)
    kiwifs mcp --root ~/knowledge

    # Proxy to remote server
    kiwifs mcp --remote https://kiwi.example.com --api-key kiwi_sk_...

    # HTTP transport
    kiwifs mcp --root ~/knowledge --http --port 8181

### Claude Desktop / Cursor config

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "kiwifs": {
          "command": "kiwifs",
          "args": ["mcp", "--root", "/path/to/knowledge"]
        }
      }
    }

### MCP Resources

    kiwi://schema            SCHEMA.md for the knowledge root
    kiwi://file/{path}       Read file by path
    kiwi://tree/{path}       Directory listing

### Tool Reference (60+)

#### Core Files and Search

| Tool                  | Description                                                       |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| kiwi_read             | Read file with optional wiki-link resolution, metadata-only, ETag |
| kiwi_write            | Create/update page with optional actor and provenance             |
| kiwi_delete           | Delete a path (history preserved with git versioning)             |
| kiwi_rename           | Move/rename with optional wiki-link rewrites                      |
| kiwi_bulk_write       | Atomic multi-file commit                                          |
| kiwi_append           | Append without read-modify-write races                            |
| kiwi_tree             | Directory listing with depth and optional permalinks              |
| kiwi_search           | BM25 full-text search with pagination and path_prefix             |
| kiwi_search_semantic  | Vector similarity search (requires embeddings)                    |
| kiwi_changes          | Incremental change list since a checkpoint                        |
| kiwi_versions         | Git history entries for a path                                    |
| kiwi_view_refresh     | Regenerate a computed kiwi-view markdown file                     |

#### Metadata, DQL, and Analytics

| Tool                  | Description                                                       |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| kiwi_query_meta       | Frontmatter filters with AND/OR groups, sort, pagination          |
| kiwi_query            | DQL queries (TABLE, LIST, COUNT, DISTINCT)                        |
| kiwi_aggregate        | GROUP BY aggregates over metadata                                 |
| kiwi_import           | Pull from databases, CSV/JSON, Notion, Airtable, etc.            |
| kiwi_ingest           | Convert binary documents to markdown                              |
| kiwi_export           | Export JSONL/CSV with optional embeddings                         |
| kiwi_export_document  | Render to PDF, HTML, slides, or static site                       |
| kiwi_analytics        | Knowledge base health metrics                                     |
| kiwi_health_check     | Single-page diagnostics                                           |
| kiwi_memory_report    | Episodic memory coverage and merge hints                          |
| kiwi_velocity         | Change hotspots, cold pages, bursts                               |
| kiwi_eval             | Search quality benchmark harness                                  |
| kiwi_context          | Schema, playbook, index, rules in one call (good first tool)      |
| kiwi_backlinks        | Incoming wiki links for a page                                    |
| kiwi_suggestions      | Semantically similar pages excluding existing links               |
| kiwi_embeddings       | Raw chunk embeddings for a page                                   |
| kiwi_graph_analytics  | PageRank-based graph summary                                     |
| kiwi_graph_centrality | PageRank and betweenness rankings per page                        |
| kiwi_graph_communities| Louvain community detection over wiki links                       |
| kiwi_graph_path       | Shortest path between two pages                                   |
| kiwi_graph_walk       | Local neighborhood and siblings around a page                     |
| kiwi_eligible         | Ranked todo-style tasks inferred from metadata                    |

## CLI Reference

    kiwifs serve         Start the HTTP server
    kiwifs init          Initialize a knowledge directory with a template
    kiwifs mcp           Start MCP server (stdio or HTTP)
    kiwifs mount         FUSE mount a remote KiwiFS
    kiwifs import        Import from databases, files, or SaaS
    kiwifs export        Export as JSONL, CSV, PDF, HTML, slides, or site
    kiwifs query         Run a DQL query
    kiwifs aggregate     SQL-style aggregation over frontmatter
    kiwifs analytics     Knowledge health dashboard
    kiwifs lint          Validate markdown
    kiwifs janitor       Full health scan
    kiwifs reindex       Rebuild search indexes
    kiwifs view          Manage computed views
    kiwifs clip          Save a web page as markdown
    kiwifs memory report Episodic memory coverage report
    kiwifs backup        Push to git remote
    kiwifs restore       Clone from git remote
    kiwifs rules         View/export .kiwi/rules.md
    kiwifs rules export  Export rules for a specific harness (--format cursor|claude|agents|openclaw)
    kiwifs rules sync    Export and write to file (e.g., .cursor/rules/kiwi.md)
    kiwifs token create  Create scoped API key (read/write/admin)
    kiwifs token list    List API keys
    kiwifs token revoke  Revoke an API key
    kiwifs login         Authenticate with KiwiFS Cloud (OAuth device flow)
    kiwifs logout        Remove stored Cloud credentials
    kiwifs whoami        Show current Cloud identity
    kiwifs connect       Generate MCP config for a KiwiFS Cloud workspace
    kiwifs bench         Performance benchmark
    kiwifs update        Self-update to latest release

---

## KiwiFS Cloud

Hosted KiwiFS at https://app.kiwifs.com. The cloud control plane manages workspaces, API keys, billing, and auth.

### Authentication

Two methods:
1. API key: Pass `kiwi_sk_*` as Bearer token
2. MCP OAuth 2.1: Browser-based login via WorkOS (PKCE)

### Cloud API

Base URL: https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/{slug}

All KiwiFS endpoints are available under this prefix. The cloud proxy authenticates you and forwards to the workspace's KiwiFS instance.

    # Write a file
    curl -X PUT "https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/{slug}/file?path=notes/hello.md" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $KIWI_API_KEY" \
      -H "X-Actor: my-app" \
      -d "# Hello World"

    # Read it back
    curl "https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/{slug}/file?path=notes/hello.md" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $KIWI_API_KEY"

    # Search
    GET /api/workspaces/{slug}/search?q=authentication

    # File tree
    GET /api/workspaces/{slug}/tree

    # MCP endpoint
    POST /api/workspaces/{slug}/mcp

### Cloud MCP Config

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "kiwi": {
          "url": "https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/{slug}/mcp"
        }
      }
    }

For CI/headless (no browser OAuth):

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "kiwi": {
          "url": "https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/{slug}/mcp",
          "headers": {
            "Authorization": "Bearer kiwi_sk_..."
          }
        }
      }
    }

### Connect CLI

    kiwifs connect <workspace-slug>

Generates and writes MCP config for the workspace.

## Access Protocols

| Protocol | Port  | Enable flag   |
|----------|-------|---------------|
| REST API | 3333  | (always on)   |
| MCP      | 8181  | --http        |
| NFS      | 2049  | --nfs         |
| S3       | 3334  | --s3          |
| WebDAV   | 3335  | --webdav      |
| FUSE     | N/A   | kiwifs mount  |

---

## Agent Playbook System

KiwiFS ships agent-facing files that teach agents how to interact with a knowledge base.

### Core files (from kiwifs init)

    SCHEMA.md            Directory layout and frontmatter field definitions
    .kiwi/playbook.md    Step-by-step MCP sequences for each operation
    .kiwi/rules.md       Harness-specific agent behavior
    index.md             Auto-maintained table of contents
    log.md               Append-only change log

### Load context in one call

    MCP:  kiwi_context
    REST: GET /api/kiwi/context

Returns schema, playbook, and index combined — the recommended first tool call for any agent session.

### Export rules for your harness

    kiwifs rules export --format cursor    # .cursorrules style
    kiwifs rules export --format claude    # CLAUDE.md style
    kiwifs rules export --format agents    # AGENTS.md style
    kiwifs rules export --format openclaw  # OpenClaw format

### Episodic Memory

Write observations to episodes/ as episodic memory. Periodically consolidate into durable pages/ using kiwi_memory_report to identify unmerged episodes.

Frontmatter for episodes: memory_kind: episodic, episode_id, derived-from, merged-from

---

## Key Concepts

- Files are truth: every page is a plain .md file with YAML frontmatter
- Wiki links: [[page-name]] syntax with fuzzy resolution and backlink tracking
- DQL: SQL-like query language over frontmatter (TABLE, LIST, COUNT, DISTINCT, WHERE, SORT, GROUP BY)
- Versioning: every write is a git commit (configurable: git, cow, none)
- Search: BM25 full-text via FTS5 + optional vector similarity via Ollama/OpenAI
- Schemas: JSON Schema validation on frontmatter by type field
- Workflows: JSON state machines with Kanban board visualization
- Drafts: git-backed staging branches for safe agent edits
- Claims: cooperative write leases to prevent concurrent edits
- Webhooks: signed HTTP POST on file create/update/delete events
- SSE: real-time event stream at GET /events
- Multi-space: multiple isolated knowledge bases on one server
